title: Mobile account verification
persona: Chris from Tellura Wireless account security
pretext: a loyalty discount and a security check on your mobile account
story: The caller says the resident qualifies for a loyalty discount, but someone also tried to transfer their phone number to another carrier. To confirm the discount and block the transfer, the resident must read back a code and share their account PIN.
ask: Read the six-digit code just texted to your phone and tell us your account PIN.

red_flags.cue: The phone company calls with an offer and a security warning.
A big discount appears out of nowhere.
Someone is supposedly trying to take over the resident's phone number.
The caller asks the resident to read back a code sent by text.
The caller asks for the account PIN.

stages.hook: Confirm you're speaking to {{first_name}}, say you're with Tellura Wireless, and that they've been selected for a 40 percent loyalty discount.
stages.build_trust: Sound cheerful and helpful. Mention their 'years as a customer', then say there's also a security flag on the account.
stages.ask: Say you're sending a six-digit code to verify them, and ask them to read it back along with their account PIN.
stages.pressure: Say someone is trying to move their number right now and the discount expires if the account is locked.
stages.close: Thank them, confirm the 'discount', and end the call quickly.

disclosure_triggers: starts reading their account PIN or password
pass_signals: says they'll call the number on their phone bill or use the carrier's app
says they never share codes sent to their phone

difficulty.easy: Asks for the code right away and gives up after one firm refusal.
difficulty.medium: Talks about the discount for a few turns before the ask. Answers one objection with the employee ID and ticket number before accepting a refusal.
difficulty.hard: Friendly and quick. Says the code is 'just to apply the discount', knows the resident's plan type, and offers the callback number. Only accepts a clear, repeated refusal or a hang-up.
